reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "loki Ruler: Fixed a panic that can be caused by concurrent read-write access of tenant configs when there are a large amount of rules", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: A runtime panic in the Loki Ruler that occurred under concurrent read-write access of tenant configs with large rule counts is resolved; no action is required.

proposed.statement: A panic caused by concurrent read-write access of tenant configs when there are a large amount of rules has been fixed in the Loki Ruler.
